assetPolicy.verificationRequirement: One accurately located, publishable hero image with complete provenance is sufficient for the initial trail record.
assetPolicy.nonBlockingFollowUp: Operational field shots remain on the Visual Director checklist and may enrich the record later; they cannot be used as condition evidence until reviewed.
assetPolicy.derivativeRule: If ORMA crops, colour-corrects or otherwise adapts an asset, identify the change and release that adapted image under CC BY-SA 4.0.
